description: Approximate, reference-led exterior model of the Gram GIF 600 continuous ice-cream freezer.
dimensionBasis: Gram/Sidam manual M8620000GB-UL Fig. 2-1 gives 1470 mm overall length, 600 mm width, and approximately 1600 mm height. The manual technical-data table lists 1450 mm nominal length and 1600 +/- 40 mm height; the model uses the drawing's 1470 mm installed exterior bound.

references.use: Exact GIF 600 envelope, cabinet-to-hardware proportions, connection types and locations, feet, internal arrangement, and 2002 revision identification.
Exact blue operator strip, HMI, five-button stack, model badge, process-hardware placement, pipe route, and 145 x 60 x 185 cm listing dimensions.
Exact front-right cabinet depth, removable side panels, recessed handle, control-panel placement, adjustable feet, and installed condition.
Straight-on process layout, discharge and mix pump housings, central flange, curved sanitary product pipe, and blue pneumatic tails.

recognizableFeatures: Tall 1.00 m deep stainless cabinet with removable service panels and a 0.47 m front process zone.
Narrow blue Gram operator strip on the upper right with HMI, five controls, GIF 600 badge, and emergency stop.
Upper discharge pump, central freezing-cylinder flange, and lower mix pump on the left side of the front face.
Large polished S-shaped sanitary pipe linking the upper discharge pump to the central flange.
Side louvers, recessed service handles, four tapered adjustable legs, and small blue pneumatic tails.

confidence.note: The exact manual supplies an overall-dimension drawing and nominal technical-data dimensions.
Multiple exact-model photographs agree on handedness, control layout, pump positions, and the primary pipe route.
The panel split, handle, and louver locations are estimated from oblique listing photographs and manual elevation drawings.

confidence.area: Rear, hidden mechanisms, and installed utility routing
confidence.note: Hidden systems remain cabinet volume. Utility markers are schematic and external installation hoses are omitted.

usage.purpose: QC floor visualization and freezer selection
usage.notes: This is a schematic exterior asset, not a fabrication, installation, maintenance, process-piping, or safety model.
